title: Evil Son Asks Cops Where to Stab His Dad Next
description:
Bodycam footage shows Oklahoma police responding to a chilling 911 call from a suspect putting the fate of his dad in the operator's hands. Police confronted Erick Nimsey, 42, at his apartment and rescued his father. But Erick wasn’t done yet. Get the full story on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
